international.title: New UK-EU youth mobility scheme may not fully launch until 2030
international.summary: Exclusive: deal expected to be sealed in principle at EU-UK summit on Friday but trickier elements could be postponed for six months The new post-Brexit UK-EU youth mobility scheme or agrifood deal may not come fully into force until 2030. It will be a disappointment to any under-30s in the UK and the EU who hoped to travel, work or study in each other’s territories from next year after the long-awaited new deal. Continue reading...
